<h2 id="部署gitlab">部署GitLab</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>安装相关依赖</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh"> yum -y install policycoreutils openssh-server openssh-clients postfix policycoreutils-python*
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>设置 启动ssh服务&amp;设置为开机启动</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">systemctl enable sshd &amp;&amp; sudo systemctl start sshd
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>设置postfix开机自启，并启动，postfix支持gitlab发信功能</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">systemctl enable postfix &amp;&amp; systemctl start postfix
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>安装软件</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">[root@gitlab ~]# rpm -ivh --nodeps gitlab-ce-16.9.0-ce.0.el7.x86_64.rpm
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805151655791-1399843202.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-06_10-02-56" loading="lazy"><br>
这样代表安装成功</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>修改配置</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">vim /etc/gitlab/gitlab.rb
修改gitlab访问地址和端口，默认为80，我们改为82
external_url 'http://192.48.75.70:82'
nginx['listen_port'] = 82
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>启动服务</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh"> gitlab-ctl reconfigure
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805151758659-1995894403.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-06_10-32-18" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>启动</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh"> gitlab-ctl restart
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>访问</p>
<blockquote>
<p>ip:82</p>
</blockquote>
<p>通过刚刚的初始化来查询密码</p>
<blockquote>
<p>这个密码有时间限制，  24h 之后就不可以在用了</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-sh">Username: root
cat /etc/gitlab/initial_root_password
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805152819303-948503705.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-05-27_14-11-49" loading="lazy"></p>
</li>
</ul>

<h3 id="将用户添加到组里面">将用户添加到组里面</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805152957859-857121696.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-09_11-51-14" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805153004063-504138016.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-09_11-51-29" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>Gitlab用户在组里面有5种不同权限：</p>
<p>​	Guest：可以创建issue、发表评论，不能读写版本库</p>
<p>​	Reporter：可以克隆代码，不能提交，QA、PM 可以赋予这个权限</p>
<p>​	Developer：可以克隆代码、开发、提交、push，普通开发可以赋予这个权限</p>
<p>​	Maintainer：可以创建项目、添加tag、保护分支、添加项目成员、编辑项目，核心开发可以赋予这个 权限</p>
<p>​	Owner：可以设置项目访问权限 - Visibility Level、删除项目、迁移项目、管理组成员，开发组组 长可以赋予这个权限</p>
</blockquote>

<h2 id="部署-jenkins">部署 Jenkins</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>设置时间同步  与  Windows</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">yum install -y chrony
systemctl start chronyd &amp;&amp; systemctl enable chronyd
timedatectl set-ntp yes &amp;&amp; timedatectl status &amp;&amp; export LC_TIME="C"
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>这里建议写一个 shell 脚本</p>
</blockquote>
</li>
<li>
<p>安装JDK</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Jenkins需要依赖JDK，所以先安装JDK21</p>
<p><code>注意： </code>  目前的   jdk21 如果要用 yum安装，我们没有相关的 秘钥，  网上大部分秘钥都已经不可用， 所以我们用  tar 包安装</p>
<p>包的地址： <a href="https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/Adoptium/21/jdk/x64/linux/OpenJDK21U-jdk_x64_linux_hotspot_21.0.7_6.tar.gz" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/Adoptium/21/jdk/x64/linux/OpenJDK21U-jdk_x64_linux_hotspot_21.0.7_6.tar.gz</a></p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-sh">mkdir -p /usr/local/java
tar -zxvf OpenJDK21U-jdk_x64_linux_hotspot_21.0.7_6.tar.gz  -C /usr/local/java

# 修改文件名称
cd /usr/local/java/
mv jdk-21.0.7+6/ jdk-21
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-sh"># 配置环境变量
vim /etc/profile
.......
# 添加到最后一行即可
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/local/java/jdk-21
export PATH=$PATH:$JAVA_HOME/bin 
export CLASSPATH=.:$JAVA_HOME/lib/dt.jar:$JAVA_HOME/lib/tools.jar

# 加载一下环境变量
source /etc/profile

# 设置开机自动加载
vim /root/.bashrc
source /etc/profile
</code></pre>
<p>测试java版本是否安装成功</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">[root@localhost ~]# java -version
openjdk version "21.0.15" 2025-04-15
OpenJDK Runtime Environment Temurin-17.0.15+6 (build 17.0.15+6)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM Temurin-17.0.15+6 (build 17.0.15+6, mixed mode, sharing)
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>获取Jenkins包</p>
<blockquote>
<p><a href="https://mirrors.aliyun.com/jenkins/redhat/jenkins-2.504-1.1.noarch.rpm" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://mirrors.aliyun.com/jenkins/redhat/jenkins-2.504-1.1.noarch.rpm</a></p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-sh">[root@jenkins ~]# rpm -ivh jenkins-2.504-1.1.noarch.rpm 
warning: jenkins-2.504-1.1.noarch.rpm: Header V4 RSA/SHA512 Signature, key ID ef5975ca: NOKEY
Verifying...                          ################################# [100%]
Preparing...                          ################################# [100%]
Updating / installing...
   1:jenkins-2.504-1.1                ################################# [100%]
/usr/lib/tmpfiles.d/dbus.conf:13: Line references path below legacy directory /var/run/, updating /var/run/dbus/containers → /run/dbus/containers; please update the tmpfiles.d/ drop-in file accordingly.
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>直接启动Jenkins</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">systemctl start jenkins
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>这里直接启动会出现启动不了的情况</p>
<blockquote>
<p>修改相关的配置</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-sh"># 查找 java 的路径
[root@localhost ~]# readlink -f $(which java)
/usr/local/java/jdk-21/bin/java


# 实际的  
JAVA_HOME=/usr/local/java/jdk-21

# 在 jenkins 的服务配置文件里修改
[root@localhost ~]# vim /usr/lib/systemd/system/jenkins.service

# 在   Service 模块里面 最后 添加  
...........
[Service]
.....
Environment=JAVA_HOME=/usr/local/java/jdk-21
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>更新损坏的war包</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh"># 完全删除旧文件
sudo rm -f /usr/share/java/jenkins.war

# 从官方镜像下载（使用中国镜像加速）
sudo wget -O /usr/share/java/jenkins.war \
    https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/jenkins/war-stable/latest/jenkins.war
    
# 验证文件可靠性
file /usr/share/java/jenkins.war
md5sum /usr/share/java/jenkins.war
ls -lh /usr/share/java/jenkins.war
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>再次重启就可以了</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl restart jenkins
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>默认端口 8080</p>
<p>访问：    ip:8080</p>
</blockquote>
</li>
<li>
<p>修改端口</p>
<blockquote>
<p>由于这是新版的 Jenkins， 没有的默认的配置文件， 我们直接在 服务文件里面 修改即可</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-sh">[root@localhost ~]# vim /usr/lib/systemd/system/jenkins.service
........

[Service]
......
ExecStart=/usr/bin/jenkins --httpPort=8090 
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>在 ExecStart 最后面添加 --httpPort=8090  即可</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-sh">sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl restart jenkins
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>默认端口 8090</p>
<p>访问：    ip:8090</p>
</blockquote>
</li>
</ul>

</code></pre>

</code></pre>

<h2 id="jenkins-权限管理">Jenkins 权限管理</h2>
<h3 id="安装授权策略插件">安装授权策略插件</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>安装插件 <mark>Role-based Authorization Strategy</mark></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805153836791-673367794.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-09_16-22-11" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805153843206-696785364.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-09_16-22-41" loading="lazy"></p>
<hr>
</li>
<li>
<p>设置策略</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805153850248-471199880.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-09_16-26-31" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805153856694-797560125.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-09_16-28-33" loading="lazy"></p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 id="创建角色">创建角色</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>进入创建角色的页面</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805153911284-471521719.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_10-02-22" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805153917385-2008701500.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_10-03-59" loading="lazy"></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>解释角色的不同定位</p>
<blockquote>
<p>Global roles：  全局角色</p>
<p>Item roles：     项目角色，  不同的项目被不同的人访问</p>
<p>Agent roles：   节点角色， jenkins 主从的时候需要</p>
</blockquote>
</li>
<li>
<p>Global roles</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805154021360-2068451213.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_10-08-48" loading="lazy"></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Item roles</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805154028947-1449645138.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_10-12-02" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>这里的  <mark>tao.*</mark> 代表可以访问   tao 前缀的项目名称</p>
</blockquote>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 id="创建用户-1">创建用户</h3>
<ul>
<li>

<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805154037063-1678939219.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_10-17-12" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805154043560-1092560294.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_10-17-35" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805154103572-1632229261.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_10-18-55" loading="lazy"><br>

<blockquote>
<p>用户名：   Eric    密码： Eric000</p>
<p>用户名： Tom      密码： Tom000</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>虽然这里创建了用户， 但是没有任何权限， 当登录的时候， 是没有任何菜单页面的</p>
</blockquote>

</ul>

<h2 id="jenkins凭证管理">Jenkins凭证管理</h2>
<h3 id="凭证初始化">凭证初始化</h3>
<blockquote>
<p>凭据可以用来存储需要密文保护的数据库密码、Gitlab密码信息、Docker私有仓库密码等，以便 Jenkins可以和这些第三方的应用进行交互。</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>
<p>安装插件 Credentials Binding</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805154857270-382004171.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_10-43-28" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805154902855-1685627764.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_10-46-16" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>安装完成之后， 会在安全的地方多两个选项</p>
</blockquote>
</li>
<li>
<p>添加凭证</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805154909010-450215597.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_10-47-54" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805154914822-465047903.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_10-48-03" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805154921223-1279195226.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_10-48-47" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805154926694-1428681403.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_10-49-15" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>​		Username with password:       用户名密码登录的凭证，  比如拉取gitlab代码</p>
<p>​		SSH Username with private key:  SSH 的免密登录</p>
<p>​		Secrret file:    需要保密的文本文件，使用时Jenkins会将文件复制到一个临时目录中，再将文件路径设置到一个变量中，等构建结束后，所复制的Secret file就会被删除。</p>
<p>​		Secret text:    需要保存的一个加密的文本串，如钉钉机器人或Github的api token</p>
<p>​		Certificate:     通过上传证书文件的方式</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="jenkins拉取gitlab代码">Jenkins拉取GitLab代码</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>安装插件  Git</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805154955371-1968732436.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_11-00-30" loading="lazy"></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>测试</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805155008065-866663147.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_11-02-38" loading="lazy"></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805155013352-1613883981.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_11-03-06" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>如果这里出现了 Git  就说明安装成功</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>
<p>在Jenkins服务器上安装  git 工具</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">[root@jenkins ~]# yum -y install git
[root@jenkins ~]# git --version
git version 1.8.3.1
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>创建凭证</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805155030000-835155322.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_11-08-09" loading="lazy"></p>

<li>
<p>配置项目</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805155042015-1838679957.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_11-09-45" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805155051586-1686822576.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_11-10-34" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805155059456-984709450.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_11-12-19" loading="lazy"></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>构建项目</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805155112224-1211850762.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_11-13-21" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>检查目录是否成功</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">[root@localhost ~]# cd /var/lib/jenkins/workspace/tao02
[root@localhost tao02]# ls
demo.iml  web
</code></pre>

<h2 id="maven安装部署">Maven安装部署</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>在Jenkins主机执行</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">[root@jenkins ~]# tar -xzf apache-maven-3.6.2-bin.tar.gz 
[root@jenkins ~]# mkdir -p /opt/maven
[root@jenkins ~]# mv apache-maven-3.6.2/* /opt/maven
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>配置环境变量</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">export MAVEN_HOME=/opt/maven
export PATH=$PATH:$JAVA_HOME/bin:$MAVEN_HOME/bin
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>加载环境变量</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">[root@jenkins ~]# source /etc/profile
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>检测</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">[root@jenkins ~]# mvn -v
Apache Maven 3.6.2 (40f52333136460af0dc0d7232c0dc0bcf0d9e117; 2019-08-27T23:06:16+08:00)
Maven home: /opt/maven
Java version: 17.0.15, vendor: Eclipse Adoptium, runtime: /usr/local/java/jdk-17
Default locale: en_US, platform encoding: UTF-8
OS name: "linux", version: "3.10.0-862.el7.x86_64", arch: "amd64", family: "unix"
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>Jenkins配置 maven</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805155322777-1934667735.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_15-13-08" loading="lazy"></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805155339034-1252110835.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_15-14-18" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805155349692-95566990.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_15-15-37" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>添加全局属性</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805155403522-1393498124.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_15-19-33" loading="lazy"></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805155438072-432526057.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_15-22-22" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">JAVA_HOME     /usr/local/java/jdk-21
M2_HOME       /opt/maven
PATH+EXTRA    $M2_HOME/bin
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>注意： 这里填入的时候， 不能有空格</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li>
<p>测试</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805155452551-923639910.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_15-36-27" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>输入构建命令</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-sh">mvn clean package
</code></pre>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805155517170-184918716.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_15-37-34" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>立即构建</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805155524234-1997996507.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_17-42-45" loading="lazy"></p>
<blockquote>
<p>到这里说明已经构建成功了</p>
</blockquote>

<h2 id="tomcat">Tomcat</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>安装jdk</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">yum install java-1.8.0-openjdk* -y
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>安装tomcat</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">tar -xzf apache-tomcat-8.5.47.tar.gz 解压
mkdir -p /opt/tomcat 创建目录
mv /root/apache-tomcat-8.5.47/* /opt/tomcat 移动文件
/opt/tomcat/bin/startup.sh 启动tomcat
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>访问</p>
<blockquote>
<p><a href="http://192.48.75.72:8080/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://192.48.75.72:8080/</a></p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805155546553-1726863551.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-10_16-48-45" loading="lazy"></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>配置权限</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">[root@tomcat ~]# vim /opt/tomcat/conf/tomcat-users.xml

  &lt;!-- 只保留必要角色 --&gt;
  &lt;role rolename="manager-script"/&gt;
  &lt;role rolename="manager-gui"/&gt;

  &lt;!-- 修正角色分配 --&gt;
  &lt;user 
    username="tomcat" 
    password="tomcat" 
    roles="manager-script,manager-gui"/&gt;
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>注意：  要把以上内容添加到 <mark><tomcat-users></tomcat-users></mark> 标签里面</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-sh">vim /opt/tomcat/webapps/manager/META-INF/context.xml
&lt;Valve 
    className="org.apache.catalina.valves.RemoteAddrValve"
    allow="192\.48\.75\..*|127\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+"/&gt; 
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>启动tomcat</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">[root@tomcat bin]# /opt/tomcat/bin/shutdown.sh 
Using CATALINA_BASE:   /opt/tomcat
Using CATALINA_HOME:   /opt/tomcat
Using CATALINA_TMPDIR: /opt/tomcat/temp
Using JRE_HOME:        /usr
Using CLASSPATH:       /opt/tomcat/bin/bootstrap.jar:/opt/tomcat/bin/tomcat-juli.jar

[root@tomcat bin]# /opt/tomcat/bin/startup.sh 
Using CATALINA_BASE:   /opt/tomcat
Using CATALINA_HOME:   /opt/tomcat
Using CATALINA_TMPDIR: /opt/tomcat/temp
Using JRE_HOME:        /usr
Using CLASSPATH:       /opt/tomcat/bin/bootstrap.jar:/opt/tomcat/bin/tomcat-juli.jar
Tomcat started.
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>访问</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805155708472-574497346.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-11_09-57-52" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805155713598-1269590632.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-11_09-58-04" loading="lazy"></p>
<hr>
<h2 id="jenkins构建项目">Jenkins构建项目</h2>
<h3 id="jenkins项目构建类型">Jenkins项目构建类型</h3>
<ul>
<li>自由风格软件项目（FreeStyle Project）</li>
<li>Maven项目（Maven Project）</li>
<li>流水线项目（Pipeline Project）</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>每种类型的构建其实都可以完成一样的构建过程与结果，只是在操作方式、灵活度等方面有所区别，在实际开发中可以根据自己的需求和习惯来选择。（个人推荐使用流水线类型，因为灵活度非常高）</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3 id="自由风格">自由风格</h3>
<blockquote>
<p>拉取代码-&gt;编译-&gt;打包-&gt;部署</p>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="创建项目-1">创建项目</h4>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805155736350-18465695.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-11_10-20-46" loading="lazy"></p>

<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805155842518-1929339227.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-11_10-23-16" loading="lazy"></p>

 mvn clean package
 echo "编译和打包结束"
</code></pre>

<h2 id="pipeline流水线项目构建">Pipeline流水线项目构建</h2>
<h3 id="介绍">介绍</h3>
<h4 id="概念">概念</h4>
<ul>
<li>Pipeline，简单来说，就是一套运行在 Jenkins 上的工作流框架，将原来独立运行于单个或者多个节点的任务连接起来，实现单个任务难以完成的复杂流程编排和可视化的工作。</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="好处">好处</h4>
<ul>
<li>代码：Pipeline以代码的形式实现，通常被检入源代码控制，使团队能够编辑，审查和迭代其传送流 程。</li>
<li>持久：无论是计划内的还是计划外的服务器重启，Pipeline都是可恢复的。</li>
<li>可停止：Pipeline可接 收交互式输入，以确定是否继续执行Pipeline。</li>
<li>多功能：Pipeline支持现实世界中复杂的持续交付要 求。它支持fork/join、循环执行，并行执行任务的功能。</li>
<li>可扩展：Pipeline插件支持其DSL的自定义扩 展 ，以及与其他插件集成的多个选项。</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="如何创建">如何创建</h4>
<ul>
<li>Pipeline  脚本是由 Groovy 语言实现的，但是我们没必要单独去学习 Groovy</li>
<li>Pipeline 支持两种语法：Declarative(声明式)和 Scripted Pipeline(脚本式)语法</li>
<li>Pipeline 也有两种创建方法：可以直接在 Jenkins 的 Web UI 界面中输入脚本；也可以通过创建一个 Jenkinsfile 脚本文件放入项目源码库中（一般我们都推荐在 Jenkins 中直接从源代码控制(SCM)中直接载入 Jenkinsfile Pipeline 这种方法）</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="安装插件">安装插件</h4>
<blockquote>
<p>Pipeline</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805160220446-354710064.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-12_11-31-59" loading="lazy"></p>
<hr>
<h3 id="pipeline语法入门">Pipeline语法入门</h3>
<h4 id="创建一个流水线项目">创建一个流水线项目</h4>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805160226758-1926134524.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-16_11-13-17" loading="lazy"></p>
<hr>
<h4 id="声明式脚本推荐">声明式脚本[推荐]<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805160237979-650001997.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-06-16_11-15-19" loading="lazy"></h4>
<pre><code class="language-pseudocode">pipeline {
    agent any

    stages {
        stage('Hello') {
            steps {
                echo 'Hello World'
            }
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="脚本式脚本不推荐">脚本式脚本[不推荐]<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805160247150-1213488800.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-07-03_14-15-33" loading="lazy"></h4>
<pre><code class="language-pseudocode">node {
    def mvnHome
    stage('Preparation') { // for display purposes
        // Get some code from a GitHub repository
        git 'https://github.com/jglick/simple-maven-project-with-tests.git'
        // Get the Maven tool.
        // ** NOTE: This 'M3' Maven tool must be configured
        // **       in the global configuration.
        mvnHome = tool 'M3'
    }
    stage('Build') {
        // Run the maven build
        withEnv(["MVN_HOME=$mvnHome"]) {
            if (isUnix()) {
                sh '"$MVN_HOME/bin/mvn" -Dmaven.test.failure.ignore clean package'
            } else {
                bat(/"%MVN_HOME%\bin\mvn" -Dmaven.test.failure.ignore clean package/)
            }
        }
    }
    stage('Results') {
        junit '**/target/surefire-reports/TEST-*.xml'
        archiveArtifacts 'target/*.jar'
    }
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h4 id="声明式详细">声明式[详细]</h4>
<blockquote>
<p>分为两个板块：</p>
<p>​	代理、环境等的一些配置</p>
<p>阶段</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-pseudocode">pipeline {
    agent any

    stages {                //所有阶段
        stage('Hello') {    //阶段（步骤）
            steps {         //操作
                echo 'Hello World'
            }
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>入门代码</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-sh">pipeline {
    agent any

    stages {
        stage('pull code') {
            steps {
                echo '拉取代码'
            }
        }
        
        stage('build project') {
            steps {
                echo '构建项目'
            }
        }
        
        stage('publish project') {
            steps {
                echo '发布项目'
            }
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>构建项目</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805160330320-2033766158.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-07-03_14-29-05" loading="lazy"></p>
<hr>

<h2 id="sonarqube">sonarQube</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>代码审查工具：   <a href="https://www.sonarqube.org" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.sonarqube.org</a></p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="基本环境-1">基本环境</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center">软件</th>
<th style="text-align: center">版本</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center">MySQL</td>
<td style="text-align: center">5.6</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center">jdk</td>
<td style="text-align: center">8</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center">sonarQube</td>
<td style="text-align: center">7.8</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="安装数据库">安装数据库</h3>
<h4 id="安装必要依赖">安装必要依赖</h4>
<pre><code class="language-sh">sudo dnf install -y libaio wget tar ncurses-compat-libs
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>注意</strong>：MySQL 5.6 需要较旧的 <code>libtinfo.so.5</code> 库，需通过 <code>ncurses-compat-libs</code> 提供兼容支持</p>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="下载-mysql-56-二进制包">下载 MySQL 5.6 二进制包</h4>
<pre><code class="language-sh">wget https://downloads.mysql.com/archives/get/p/23/file/mysql-5.6.51-linux-glibc2.12-x86_64.tar.gz
</code></pre>
<h4 id="解压并移动到安装目录">解压并移动到安装目录</h4>
<pre><code class="language-sh">sudo tar -zxvf mysql-5.6.51-linux-glibc2.12-x86_64.tar.gz -C /usr/local/
sudo mv /usr/local/mysql-5.6.51-linux-glibc2.12-x86_64 /usr/local/mysql
</code></pre>
<h4 id="创建-mysql-系统用户和组">创建 MySQL 系统用户和组</h4>
<pre><code class="language-sh">sudo groupadd mysql
sudo useradd -r -g mysql -s /bin/false mysql
</code></pre>
<h4 id="初始化数据库">初始化数据库</h4>
<pre><code class="language-sh">sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/mysql/data
sudo chown -R mysql:mysql /usr/local/mysql

# 使用旧版初始化脚本
sudo /usr/local/mysql/scripts/mysql_install_db \
  --user=mysql \
  --basedir=/usr/local/mysql \
  --datadir=/usr/local/mysql/data
</code></pre>
<h4 id="创建配置文件">创建配置文件</h4>
<p>编辑 <code>/etc/my.cnf</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">[mysqld]
basedir = /usr/local/mysql
datadir = /usr/local/mysql/data
port = 3306
socket = /tmp/mysql.sock
user = mysql

[client]
socket = /tmp/mysql.sock
</code></pre>
<h4 id="配置-systemd-服务">配置 systemd 服务</h4>
<p>创建文件 <code>/etc/systemd/system/mysqld.service</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">[Unit]
Description=MySQL Server
After=network.target

[Service]
User=mysql
Group=mysql
ExecStart=/usr/local/mysql/bin/mysqld --defaults-file=/etc/my.cnf
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
</code></pre>
<h4 id="启动-mysql-服务">启动 MySQL 服务</h4>
<pre><code class="language-sh">sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl start mysqld
sudo systemctl enable mysqld
</code></pre>
<h4 id="设置-root-密码">设置 root 密码</h4>
<pre><code class="language-sh"># 首次登录（默认无密码）
/usr/local/mysql/bin/mysql -u root
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-sql">-- 在 MySQL 中执行
SET PASSWORD FOR 'root'@'localhost' = PASSWORD('你的新密码');
FLUSH PRIVILEGES;
</code></pre>
<h4 id="配置环境变量可选">配置环境变量（可选）</h4>
<pre><code class="language-sh">echo 'export PATH=/usr/local/mysql/bin:$PATH' | sudo tee /etc/profile.d/mysql.sh
source /etc/profile.d/mysql.sh
</code></pre>
<h4 id="创建数据库">创建数据库</h4>
<pre><code class="language-sql">mysql&gt; create database sonar;
Query OK, 1 row affected (0.00 sec)

mysql&gt; 
mysql&gt; 
mysql&gt; show databases;
+--------------------+
| Database           |
+--------------------+
| information_schema |
| mysql              |
| performance_schema |
| sonar              |
| test               |
+--------------------+
5 rows in set (0.00 sec)
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 id="安装jdk8">安装jdk8</h3>
<pre><code class="language-sh">yum install java-1.8.0-openjdk* -y
</code></pre>
<h3 id="安装sonarqube">安装sonarQube</h3>
<h4 id="下载软件包">下载软件包</h4>
<pre><code class="language-sh">https://binaries.sonarsource.com/Distribution/sonarqube/sonarqube-7.8.zip
</code></pre>
<h4 id="解压软件包">解压软件包</h4>
<pre><code class="language-sh">unzip sonarqube-7.8.zip
</code></pre>
<h4 id="创建目录并移动软件包">创建目录并移动软件包</h4>
<pre><code class="language-sh">mkdir -p /opt/sonar
mv sonarqube-7.8/* /opt/sonar
</code></pre>
<h4 id="修改配置文件">修改配置文件</h4>
<pre><code class="language-sh">[root@sonarQube ~]# vim /opt/sonar/conf/sonar.properties 

sonar.jdbc.username=root
sonar.jdbc.password=54877846Rt@.
sonar.jdbc.url=jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/sonar?useUnicode=true&amp;characterEncoding=utf8&amp;rewriteBatchedStatements=true&amp;useConfigs=maxPerformance&amp;useSSL=false
</code></pre>
<h4 id="创建用户-2">创建用户</h4>
<pre><code class="language-sh">useradd sonar
</code></pre>
<h4 id="赋予权限">赋予权限</h4>
<pre><code class="language-sh">chown -R sonar. /opt/sonar
</code></pre>
<h4 id="修改内核数据">修改内核数据</h4>
<pre><code class="language-sh"># 编辑系统配置文件
echo "vm.max_map_count=262144" &gt;&gt; /etc/sysctl.conf

# 重新加载配置
sysctl -p
</code></pre>
<h4 id="启动服务">启动服务</h4>
<pre><code class="language-sh">su - sonar -c "/opt/sonar/bin/linux-x86-64/sonar.sh start"
su - sonar -c "/opt/sonar/bin/linux-x86-64/sonar.sh status"
</code></pre>

<h4 id="sonaqube-关闭审查结果上传到scm功能">SonaQube 关闭审查结果上传到SCM功能</h4>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805162421010-81633760.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-07-07_15-41-40" loading="lazy"></p>
<hr>
<h2 id="jenkins-整合--sonarqube">jenkins 整合  sonarQube</h2>
<h3 id="安装插件-1">安装插件</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805160843504-1824229344.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-07-07_15-15-05" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="jenkins安装sonar-sanner">Jenkins安装sonar-sanner</h3>
<blockquote>
<p>jenkins 主机上安装</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-sh">wget https://binaries.sonarsource.com/Distribution/sonar-scanner-cli/sonar-scanner-cli-4.2.0.1873-linux.zip

# 解压安装
unzip sonar-scanner-cli-4.2.0.1873-linux.zip -d /opt
mv /opt/sonar-scanner-4.2.0.1873-linux /opt/sonar-scanner

# 设置环境变量
echo 'export PATH=$PATH:/opt/sonar-scanner/bin' | sudo tee -a /etc/profile
source /etc/profile

# 验证安装
sonar-scanner -v
</code></pre>
<h3 id="配置全局选项">配置全局选项</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805161052642-695707982.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-07-07_16-08-50" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="添加凭证">添加凭证</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805161018624-431104170.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-07-07_15-25-39" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="系统配置">系统配置</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805161033176-1998598581.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-07-07_15-27-09" loading="lazy"></p>
<hr>
<h2 id="在项目添加sonaqube代码审查非流水线项目">在项目添加SonaQube代码审查（非流水线项目）</h2>
<h3 id="配置构建">配置构建</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805161115518-1475060565.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-07-07_15-43-06" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805161127751-1720034671.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-07-07_15-46-36" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-sh"># must be unique in a given SonarQube instance
 sonar.projectKey=demo01
 # this is the name and version displayed in the SonarQube UI. Was mandatory 
prior to SonarQube 6.1.
 sonar.projectName=web_demo
 sonar.projectVersion=1.0
 # Path is relative to the sonar-project.properties file. Replace "\" by "/" on Windows.
 # This property is optional if sonar.modules is set.
 sonar.sources=.
 sonar.exclusions=**/test/**,**/target/**
 sonar.java.source=21
 sonar.java.target=21
 # Encoding of the source code. Default is default system encoding
 sonar.sourceEncoding=UTF-8
</code></pre>
<h3 id="检测-1">检测</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805161144407-205219463.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-07-07_16-10-07" loading="lazy"></p>
<hr>
<h2 id="在项目添加sonaqube代码审查流水线项目">在项目添加SonaQube代码审查（流水线项目）</h2>
<h3 id="项目根目录下创建sonar-projectproperties文件">项目根目录下，创建sonar-project.properties文件</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805161200968-86643804.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-07-07_16-18-08" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-sh"># must be unique in a given SonarQube instance
sonar.projectKey=demo01
# this is the name and version displayed in the SonarQube UI. Was mandatory prior to SonarQube 6.1.
sonar.projectName=web_demo
sonar.projectVersion=1.0
# Path is relative to the sonar-project.properties file. Replace "\" by "/" on Windows.
# This property is optional if sonar.modules is set.
sonar.sources=.
sonar.exclusions=**/test/**,**/target/**
sonar.java.source=21
sonar.java.target=21
# Encoding of the source code. Default is default system encoding
sonar.sourceEncoding=UTF-8
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>这里修改之后， 不要忘记更新代码到  Gitlab 仓库</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="修改jenkinsfile加入sonarqube代码审查阶段">修改Jenkinsfile，加入SonarQube代码审查阶段</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2979143/202608/2979143-20260805161214043-171171362.png" alt="Snipaste_2025-07-07_16-34-07" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">pipeline {
    agent any

    stages {
        stage('pull code') {
            steps {
                checkout scmGit(branches: [[name: '*/master']], extensions: [], userRemoteConfigs: [[credentialsId: '28d46438-c565-449e-8099-f2e7cccca9de', url: 'http://192.48.75.70:82/tom.com/helloword.git']])
            }
        }

        stage('code checking') {
            steps {
                script {
                    //引入 sonarQubeSanner工具
                    scannerHome = tool 'sonarqube'
                }
                    //引入 SonarQube  服务环境
                withSonarQubeEnv('sonar-scanner') {
                    sh "${scannerHome}/bin/sonar-scanner"
                }
            }
        }

        stage('build project') {
            steps {
                sh 'mvn clean package'
            }
        }

        stage('publish project') {
            steps {
                deploy adapters: [tomcat9(credentialsId: 'bddeda71-2b0c-4e2c-850e-a082b962c2b8', path: '', url: 'http://192.48.75.72:8080/')], contextPath: null, war: 'target/*.war'
            }
        }
    }
}

</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>这里修改之后， 不要忘记更新代码到  Gitlab 仓库</p>
</blockquote>
